title: Choosing the Right Fitting: Sanitary Tee vs. Wye
description: Using the wrong drainage fitting on horizontal runs can lead to recurring blockages and failed inspections. Sanitary tees are designed specifically for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow, or vertical to horizontal in venting applications. For horizontal-to-horizontal drainage junctions, a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye must be used. This creates a gradual directional sweep that directs wastewater downstream smoothly without creating splashback or flow restriction. Always select fittings according to code and flow orientation.
